name: Ohio
agency: Ohio Bureau of Motor Vehicles (Ohio Department of Public Safety)
permitAge: 15 and a half (temporary instruction permit, valid one year; ORC 4507.05)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, certified by a parent or guardian affidavit (secondary sources)
teen.nightLimit: Probationary license: first 12 months no driving midnight to 6 a.m.; after 12 months 1 a.m. to 5 a.m.; unless with a parent or guardian. Exceptions such as work (with written employer documentation), school or religious events (ORC 4507.071).
teen.passengerLimit: First year of probationary license: no more than one non-family passenger unless a parent or guardian is along (secondary sources; not confirmed in statute text)
teen.phone: All drivers: hand-held phone use is a primary offense since April 4, 2023 (SB 288); more than a single touch or swipe is illegal in most cases; first offense $150 or a distracted driving course, $250 second, $500 third within two years.

notes: Permit supervisor once the holder is 16: licensed driver 21 or older in the front passenger seat; under 16, a parent, guardian or eligible adult (secondary).
Driver education: 24 hours classroom plus 8 hours behind the wheel (secondary).
Knowledge test: sources say 40 questions and 75 percent; some describe two 20-question parts (signs and rules). Not confirmed on a BMV page, so exam fields are null.

Digest of Ohio Motor Vehicle Laws: a 2024 Legislative Service Commission analysis says the BMV publishes it in English, Somali and Spanish. No direct PDF URL found. HB 616 (136th GA) would require every test language.
SB 419 (136th GA) would lower the permit age to 15 and lengthen the holding period to one year; status unknown, so not used in questions.
Move over (ORC 4511.213): move over one lane for any stationary vehicle with flashing or rotating lights, or slow down if not possible; expanded in Dec. 2013.
School bus (ORC 4511.75): on roads with four or more lanes, only traffic in the same direction as the bus must stop.
Research done with WebSearch only; official sites were unreachable from the sandbox (proxy 403).
